name: GitHub
description: Pull requests, issues, reviews and comments.

auth.label: Personal access token
auth.hint: Create one at github.com/settings/tokens. It stays in your Keychain.

note: GitHub's official remote server. It has no client registration, so you sign in with a personal access token instead of a browser.

name: Linear
description: Read and update issues, cycles and projects.
note: Linear's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Postgres
description: Read-only queries against a database you point it at.

auth.label: Connection string
auth.hint: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db. It stays in your Keychain.

note: Runs the reference Postgres server with npx. Needs Node. That package is no longer maintained upstream.

name: Stripe
note: Stripe's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Browser
description: A real browser each agent can drive: open pages, click, fill and read.
note: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server, run with npx. It opens its own browser, not hz's embedded one, so there is no take-over.

name: Slack
description: Let agents read and answer in your Slack channels.

auth.label: Slack app
auth.hint: Slack does not register clients for you. Create a Slack app and paste its client ID and secret.

note: Slack's official remote server. It needs a Slack app you register; hz has not signed in to it.

name: Google Drive
description: Search, read and save documents and sheets.

auth.label: Google OAuth client
auth.hint: Google does not register clients for you. Create a Desktop OAuth client in Google Cloud and paste its ID and secret.

note: Google's official remote server. Its tool list is public; signing in needs your own Google OAuth client.

name: Figma
description: Read frames and comments from your files.
note: Figma's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Notion
description: Pages and databases as agent memory you can read.
note: Notion's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Sentry
description: Errors and releases, with stack traces.
note: Sentry's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Vercel
note: Vercel's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Supabase
description: Tables, auth and storage for your project.
note: Supabase's official remote server, with OAuth and dynamic client registration.

name: Gmail
description: Read threads and draft replies. It cannot send.

auth.label: Google OAuth client
auth.hint: Google does not register clients for you. Create a Desktop OAuth client in Google Cloud and paste its ID and secret.

note: Google's official remote server. Its tool list is public; signing in needs your own Google OAuth client.

name: Google Calendar
description: Find free time and draft invites.

auth.label: Google OAuth client
auth.hint: Google does not register clients for you. Create a Desktop OAuth client in Google Cloud and paste its ID and secret.

note: Google's official remote server. Its tool list is public; signing in needs your own Google OAuth client.
